To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

politeness related features of Greek political science discourse undergo 'degeneration' under the influence of hegemonic English discourse; the relational aspect of politeness undergoes 'degeneration' as manifested through translated political science discourse; the 'degeneration' of politeness related aspects in political science discourse seems to be an effect, at least in part, of globalization; and, finally, there is some variation in the way politeness devices are rendered over time.

politeness shifts in Greek political science discourse can be traced in translation, and that the relative importance of politeness aspects is changing in the direction of the English source language.
politeness features are changing under the influence English in Greek political science discourse and that this change is manifested in the suppression of the local positive politeness pattern.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role that translation practice can play as a catalyst in the change of linguistic and cultural systems.
politeness in translation, as a language contact phenomenon which may be seen as a case of language change in the target system.
the effect of translation on language and culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cumulative effect of translation practice in a language is to bring about change.

the study has shown that politeness features in Greek political science discourse have undergone a change in their use, which can be attributed to the influence of English political science discourse, as a consequence of the translation practice of political science works.

politeness is a dynamic and complex construct, and its treatment in translation practice is a dynamic and multifaceted phenomenon, whose analysis requires the consideration of a number of parameters, which are not all covered by the present study.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
translation is a language contact situation, and it is a change situation, and it can bring about change.
politeness is a complex phenomenon, which cannot be reduced to one or two dimensions.
politeness features in English Greek political discourse are changing over the years, as a result of the influence of English on the Greek target system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the study of politeness shifts can provide an insight into the nature of translation and language contact.
translation can be a language change situation and that the effect of this is a gradual suppression of local linguistic features in favor of hegemonic ones.
translation is an agent of change, which can bring about changes to the target language, even when the target is not a minority or endangered language.
